pins.title: Apple Watch Dead by Bedtime? Battery Life vs Oura Ring for Overnight Sleep Tracking
pins.subtitle: Your charging habit decides what you wear to bed
pins.description: If your Apple Watch is regularly low by bedtime, tracking sleep means moving your charge to shower time or your morning routine. Oura Ring is designed for all-night wear, with a charging cadence measured in days rather than a daily top-up. Apple Watch Ultra 3 holds up better overnight if you want to stay with one wrist device. Neither is a medical device. Not medical advice. #applewatch #ouraring #sleeptracking #wearables #sleeptracker

pins.title: Why Apple Watch and Oura Ring Show Different Deep Sleep Numbers
pins.subtitle: Both are estimates. Watch the trend.
pins.description: Same night, two different deep sleep totals? Deep sleep is short, happens mostly in the first half of the night, and each algorithm reads heart-rate variability and movement differently. The wrist is also a noisier sensor spot than the base of a finger. Neither number is exact; the trend over weeks matters more than one night. Both are wellness estimates, not diagnostic tools. Not medical advice. #applewatch #ouraring #deepsleep #sleeptracker
